# DeployBar

> DeployBar is a free, open-source, local-first macOS menu bar app for monitoring cloud deployment status.

Canonical website: https://deploy.bar/
Source code: https://github.com/snapre/DeployBar
Latest release: https://github.com/snapre/DeployBar/releases/latest
License: MIT

## What DeployBar does

DeployBar replaces repeatedly checking cloud deployment dashboards with one native macOS menu bar status. It sends native notifications when a deployment starts, succeeds, fails, cancels, or disappears.

## Supported deployment providers

- Vercel
- Railway
- Netlify
- Render
- Cloudflare Pages
- Cloudflare Workers
- DigitalOcean App Platform
- Heroku
- Fly.io
- GitHub Deployments
- GitLab Deployments

## Installation

Install the signed and Apple-notarized Homebrew Cask:

`brew install --cask snapre/tap/deploybar`

DeployBar requires macOS 13 or later.

## Privacy and architecture

- Provider API tokens stay in macOS Keychain.
- Non-secret settings stay in local JSON under Application Support.
- DeployBar has no backend account, telemetry, or hosted credential sync.
- The app is native Swift 6 with SwiftUI and AppKit, not Electron.
- DeployBar is free and open source under the MIT License.
